evals.prompt: Build a one-page website for my house painting business. The quote form posts to my existing form-provider endpoint; there is no custom backend to build or change. Preserve the supplied fields and use placeholder business copy where needed. I cannot reply during this task; record only meaningful unresolved questions and low-impact assumptions, then proceed. Do not send real submissions.
evals.expected_output: A frontend-only website using one appropriate design skill; desktop and mobile browser screenshots inspected; concise root changelog.md. No SPEC.md or backend interview/tests-first workflow. README updated if it exists and setup changes.
assertions: No SPEC.md is created or required for this frontend-only task
Exactly one appropriate design skill is selected and its workflow is followed
No backend interview or backend tests-first gate is imposed
Existing facts such as the form destination and frontend-only scope are not asked again
Desktop and mobile browser screenshots are captured and visually inspected
changelog.md exists at the project root and records the meaningful change and actual verification concisely
No live submissions are sent and unperformed checks are not claimed as passing

evals.prompt: Make me a Python Telegram bot that checks Hacker News and TechCrunch RSS feeds every hour and posts new articles to my channel with a one-line summary. I cannot reply during this task: write meaningful questions and clearly labeled assumptions to questions.md, continue independent work, and do not send real posts. Do not treat unknown spending or posting permissions as approved.
evals.expected_output: Thoughtful unresolved questions without repeating supplied facts; product-only SPEC.md with multiple specific success/failure criteria; technical research and run/test commands outside SPEC.md; tests/manual checks before behavior changes; concise changelog.md including limitations.
assertions: Questions concern unresolved behavior such as summary method, backlog, duplicate handling, recovery and budgets; they do not ask the already supplied language, sources or hourly schedule
Unconfirmed product rules, spending and external action permissions remain visibly unapproved rather than being silently assumed
SPEC.md contains goal, scope, constraints, input/output expectations, and multiple distinct success and failure criteria tied to observable scenarios
Acceptance coverage includes meaningful normal, duplicate, empty/malformed feed, outage, restart/retry and cost cases where relevant, rather than a few generic wishes
SPEC.md contains no implementation plan, progress/status log, test execution results or setup commands
Library research and exact run/test commands are documented outside the product agreement
Meaningful checks are defined before implementing the relevant behavior and expected results match the agreement
changelog.md summarizes meaningful changes, actual verification/environment and unresolved work without a tool-by-tool log
No real Telegram posts or paid model calls occur without the required authorization

evals.prompt: I want an AI agent that reads my Gmail inbox each morning and gives me a short prioritized list of messages that need a reply. It must never send email or change mailbox state. Before building, ask me whatever is meaningfully unresolved. You can inspect existing project context. I have not yet defined which messages count as needing a reply.
evals.expected_output: A gap-driven interview exploring real message examples, priorities, delivery, timing, privacy and cost only where unresolved. A product agreement after sufficient clarity, with distinct scenario-based success/failure criteria and explicit read-only scope. Technical plans, commands, progress and evidence outside SPEC.md; required changelog.md.
assertions: The agent asks meaningful follow-up questions using concrete message examples instead of asking whether email sending is permitted or restating known requirements
The agent does not stop after two rounds if material classification, privacy, delivery or budget decisions remain unresolved
The agent makes routine inspectable technical choices itself rather than asking the user to discover technical facts
Success and failure definitions cover actual classification examples and relevant false-positive, missed-message, duplicate-report, permission and cost limits without inventing thresholds
Read-only mailbox behavior is preserved in the agreement and expected test results
Unresolved product decisions remain unapproved and only dependent work is blocked
SPEC.md remains a product agreement; design, progress, commands and verification history stay outside it
changelog.md records meaningful work and what was or was not verified honestly

evals.prompt: Resume our backend project. SPEC.md already says retries must not duplicate records. The README documents the test command, and changelog.md says the retry test failed last session. Inspect the current implementation and fix the retry behavior. Do not change that requirement.
evals.expected_output: Resume using agreement, README, changelog and current code/tests; reproduce the mismatch and fix code without weakening acceptance criteria; concise verification entry in changelog.md.
assertions: Resumption uses SPEC.md, README, latest relevant changelog.md and implementation evidence rather than expecting a Status section in SPEC.md
The agent does not repeat already answered product questions
The duplicate-prevention agreement and expected business result are preserved when implementation fails
Relevant checks are run and results/environment are recorded in changelog.md
No Status section, build plan or delivery report is added to SPEC.md

evals.prompt: Fix the mobile spacing of the existing homepage hero. Keep the copy, links and established design. There are no backend changes. The project currently has no changelog.md.
evals.expected_output: A focused frontend fix using the existing-design workflow, with inspected desktop/mobile screenshots and a newly created concise changelog.md. No spec or backend interview.
assertions: The agent makes a focused frontend change without requiring or creating SPEC.md
Existing copy, links, design and unrelated naming are preserved
The agent verifies and inspects screenshots at both desktop and mobile sizes
A lowercase project-root changelog.md is created with the change, why and actual verification
No verbose action log or backend questionnaire is imposed
